name: The Velvet Underground

whyMatters.en: New York band formed around Lou Reed and John Cale. Andy Warhol sponsored the debut and designed its banana cover; The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967) and White Light/White Heat (1968) sold poorly then became core citations for punk, noise, and indie—Julian Casablancas later described White Light/White Heat as a record you hear in a bad mood in a dive bar.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约乐队，围绕 Lou Reed 与 John Cale 组建。Andy Warhol 赞助首专并设计香蕉封面；The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）与 White Light/White Heat（1968）当时销量差，后成朋克、噪声与 indie 核心引用——Julian Casablancas 后来形容 White Light/White Heat 是要坐在破酒吧、心情糟透时听的唱片。

lyricQuotes: Heroin, be the death of me / Heroin, it's my wife and it's my life

shortBio.en: Reed / Cale New York rock, 1964–. Warhol banana debut and White Light/White Heat are the early core; Loaded has Sweet Jane; Reed’s Transformer followed with Bowie/Ronson.
shortBio.zh: Reed／Cale 纽约摇滚，1964 年起。Warhol 香蕉首专与 White Light/White Heat 是早期核心；Loaded 有 Sweet Jane；Reed 随后与 Bowie／Ronson 做 Transformer。

body.en:
Lou Reed and classically trained John Cale formed The Primitives, then added Sterling Morrison (known to Reed from Syracuse University). A paperback on sadomasochism suggested the name The Velvet Underground. First percussionist Angus MacLise quit before a paid show; Maureen “Moe” Tucker joined—her heavy, minimal drumming became part of the sound.

Late 1965, Andy Warhol saw them at Cafe Bizarre, became their patron, and brought in Nico. He funded the debut LP and designed its banana cover. Sales were near zero (US #171—their highest studio-album chart placing), but Heroin, Waiting for the Man, Run Run Run, and Venus in Furs set a cool, explicit tone few peers matched. All Tomorrow’s Parties was Warhol’s favorite.

White Light/White Heat (1968) was deliberately lo-fi and distorted. Julian Casablancas told Rolling Stone it is a record you need to hear in a bad mood in a dive bar. Sister Ray runs about 17 minutes. Cale left in 1968; Doug Yule replaced him. The Velvet Underground (1969) emphasized melody—I’m Set Free, Beginning to See the Light, What Goes On, Pale Blue Eyes. On Loaded (1970; Tucker pregnant and absent), Reed left after delivering Sweet Jane and Rock & Roll. Morrison left in 1971 for English literature study; Yule-led lineups continued into 1973 with little output.

Reed’s Transformer (1972), produced with David Bowie and Mick Ronson, yielded Walk on the Wild Side. Berlin (1973), Metal Machine Music (1975), and later New York (1989) marked further solo phases. After Warhol’s 1987 death, Reed and Cale made Songs for Drella (1990). The original four reunited for LIVE MCMXCIII (1993); a Reed–Cale quarrel cancelled US plans. After Morrison’s 1995 death, Reed, Cale, and Tucker played Last Night I Said Goodbye to My Friend at the 1996 Rock Hall induction. Later citations include Modern Lovers, Arcade Fire, Roxy Music, Bowie, Joy Division, Sonic Youth, Jesus and Mary Chain, and The Strokes’ deadpan delivery.
body.zh:
Lou Reed 与受过古典训练的 John Cale 组建 The Primitives，再加入 Sterling Morrison（雪城大学时已认识 Reed）。一本关于性虐待的平装书启发了校名 The Velvet Underground。首位打击乐手 Angus MacLise 在一场付费演出前退出；Maureen “Moe” Tucker 加入——她沉重、极简的鼓点成为声音一部分。

1965 年底 Andy Warhol 在 Cafe Bizarre 看过演出后成为赞助人，并引入 Nico。他出资首张 LP，并设计香蕉封面。销量近零（美榜第 171——录音室专辑最高名次），但 Heroin、Waiting for the Man、Run Run Run、Venus in Furs 以冷静、直白的毒品与施虐受虐题材少有同辈可比。All Tomorrow’s Parties 是 Warhol 最爱的 Velvet 歌曲。

White Light/White Heat（1968）有意做成低保真、高失真。Julian Casablancas 对《滚石》说，这是一张要坐在破酒吧、心情糟透时听的唱片。Sister Ray 约 17 分钟。Cale 1968 年离队，由 Doug Yule 接替。The Velvet Underground（1969）强调旋律——I’m Set Free、Beginning to See the Light、What Goes On、Pale Blue Eyes。Loaded（1970；Tucker 因怀孕未参加）上 Reed 交出 Sweet Jane、Rock & Roll 后离队。Morrison 1971 年离队攻读英国文学；Yule 主导的编制延续到 1973 年，产出很少。

Reed 的 Transformer（1972）由 David Bowie 与 Mick Ronson 联合制作，含 Walk on the Wild Side。Berlin（1973）、Metal Machine Music（1975）与后来的 New York（1989）是个人阶段节点。Warhol 1987 年去世后，Reed 与 Cale 合作 Songs for Drella（1990）。最初四人重组并有 LIVE MCMXCIII（1993）；Reed–Cale 争吵取消美国巡演计划。Morrison 1995 年去世后，Reed、Cale、Tucker 在 1996 年摇滚名人堂入选礼上演奏 Last Night I Said Goodbye to My Friend。后期引用包括 Modern Lovers、Arcade Fire、Roxy Music、Bowie、Joy Division、Sonic Youth、Jesus and Mary Chain，以及 The Strokes 面无表情的念白方式。

note.en: From the Warhol-sponsored banana-cover debut; explicit drug lyric, two-chord form.
note.zh: 出自 Warhol 赞助的香蕉封面首专；直白毒品歌词、两和弦曲式。

note.en: Debut-era S&M theme; Cale viola under Reed’s flat vocal.
note.zh: 首专时期施虐受虐题材；Cale 中提琴衬 Reed 平声。

note.en: About 17 minutes on White Light/White Heat; deliberate lo-fi distortion.
note.zh: White Light/White Heat 上约 17 分钟；有意的低保真失真。

note.en: From Loaded; Reed called it a farewell album full of hits. Tucker absent (pregnancy).
note.zh: 出自 Loaded；Reed 称之为录满热门的临别专辑。Tucker 因怀孕未参加。

body.en:
Reed and Cale’s Primitives added Morrison, took the Velvet Underground name, lost MacLise before a paid gig, and gained Tucker’s drums. Late 1965 Warhol saw them at Cafe Bizarre, became patron, and chose Nico.

He funded the debut and designed the banana cover. Chart peak was US #171. Heroin, Waiting for the Man, and Venus in Furs set the band’s early subject matter; All Tomorrow’s Parties was Warhol’s favorite Velvet song.
body.zh:
Reed 与 Cale 的 Primitives 加入 Morrison，改名 Velvet Underground；MacLise 在付费演出前退出，Tucker 加入打鼓。1965 年底 Warhol 在 Cafe Bizarre 看过演出后成为赞助人，并选定 Nico。

他出资首专并设计香蕉封面。榜单最高美第 171。Heroin、Waiting for the Man、Venus in Furs 确立早期题材；All Tomorrow’s Parties 是 Warhol 最爱的 Velvet 歌曲。

alt.zh: Velvet Underground & Nico 宣传照，约 1966——Reed、Morrison、Cale、Tucker、Nico

body.en:
White Light/White Heat (1968) was recorded with intentional low fidelity and heavy distortion. Julian Casablancas told Rolling Stone it is a record you sit with in a dive bar when you feel terrible.

The title track praises amphetamine; The Gift is a spoken story by Cale; Sister Ray runs about 17 minutes with slurred lyrics.
body.zh:
White Light/White Heat（1968）有意做成低保真与高失真。Julian Casablancas 对《滚石》说，这是一张要坐在破酒吧、心情糟透时听的唱片。

同名主打歌写安非他命；The Gift 由 Cale 讲述；Sister Ray 约 17 分钟，歌词含混。

alt.en: Velvet Underground White Light/White Heat publicity photo, c. 1968
alt.zh: Velvet Underground《White Light/White Heat》宣传照，约 1968

body.en:
Cale left in 1968; Doug Yule replaced him. The 1969 self-titled album dropped Cale’s avant-garde edge for melody and harmony—I’m Set Free, What Goes On, Pale Blue Eyes.

On Loaded (1970), Tucker was absent (pregnancy). Reed left after what he called an album full of hits, including Sweet Jane and Rock & Roll. Morrison left in 1971; Yule-led lineups produced little through 1973.
body.zh:
Cale 1968 年离队，由 Doug Yule 接替。1969 同名专辑弱化先锋色彩，转向旋律与和声——I’m Set Free、What Goes On、Pale Blue Eyes。

Loaded（1970）时 Tucker 因怀孕缺席。Reed 自称交出一张录满热门的专辑（含 Sweet Jane、Rock & Roll）后离队。Morrison 1971 年离队；Yule 主导编制至 1973 年产出很少。

body.en:
Reed’s Transformer (1972), with David Bowie and Mick Ronson, brought Walk on the Wild Side. Berlin (1973) was a bleak concept album; Metal Machine Music (1975) was a double album of noise that split listeners; Coney Island Baby (1975) restored melody.

After Warhol’s 1987 death, Reed and Cale made Songs for Drella (1990). The original four reunited for LIVE MCMXCIII (1993); Reed–Cale conflict cancelled a US tour. After Morrison’s 1995 death, Reed, Cale, and Tucker played at the 1996 Rock Hall induction.
body.zh:
Reed 的 Transformer（1972）由 David Bowie 与 Mick Ronson 参与，含 Walk on the Wild Side。Berlin（1973）是灰暗概念专集；Metal Machine Music（1975）是噪声双专辑，听众分裂；Coney Island Baby（1975）恢复旋律。

Warhol 1987 年去世后，Reed 与 Cale 做 Songs for Drella（1990）。最初四人重组有 LIVE MCMXCIII（1993）；Reed–Cale 冲突取消美国巡演。Morrison 1995 年去世后，三人在 1996 年摇滚名人堂入选礼上演出。

body.en:
Book accounts place the legacy in Modern Lovers’ and Arcade Fire’s rhythm weight, Roxy Music and Bowie’s art rock, Joy Division’s darkness, Jesus and Mary Chain’s white noise, Sonic Youth’s collapse textures, and The Strokes’ deadpan delivery.

1970s sales were low; later reissues fixed the early records in the underground canon.
body.zh:
书中将遗产落到 Modern Lovers 与 Arcade Fire 的节奏重量、Roxy Music 与 Bowie 的艺术摇滚、Joy Division 的黑暗、Jesus and Mary Chain 的白噪声、Sonic Youth 的崩溃质感，以及 The Strokes 面无表情的念白。

1970 年代销量低；后期再版使早期唱片进入地下经典目录。

body.en: From The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967). Two-chord form; Warhol-era debut track on the banana-cover LP.
body.zh: 出自 The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）。两和弦曲式；Warhol 时期香蕉封面首专曲目。
